items.raw_excerpt: Billu Chandrasekhar appointed UAE Coordinator for APNRTS to support Andhra Pradesh's non-resident Telugu community and address grievances.
items.summary_en: Billu Chandrasekhar has been appointed as the UAE Coordinator for the Andhra Pradesh Non-Resident Telugu Society. The role aims to support the Telugu community living abroad and help address their concerns.
items.summary_ko: 빌루 찬드라세카르가 안드라프라데시 비거주 텔루구 협회의 UAE 조정관으로 임명되었습니다. 이 직책은 해외 텔루구 커뮤니티를 지원하고 문제를 해결하는 것을 목표로 합니다.

items.raw_excerpt: The Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) said 66 complaints have been lodged, with pre-payment losses amounting to over S$271,000.
items.summary_en: A Korean wedding photography studio in Singapore shut down without warning. More than 60 couples lost over S$271,000 in prepayments. The Consumers Association of Singapore is now handling complaints.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르의 한국인 웨딩 사진 스튜디오가 갑자기 영업을 중단했습니다. 60쌍 이상의 예비부부가 27만1000싱가포르달러가 넘는 선납금을 잃었습니다. 싱가포르 소비자협회가 피해 접수를 받고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Korea Artiz Studio suddenly closes in Singapore, leaving engaged couples with big losses

items.title_original: ‘My heart sank’: Abrupt closure of Korea Artiz Studio leaves engaged couples in limbo

items.raw_excerpt: Mixed conditions expected across Portugal this weekend.
items.summary_en: Portugal will see mixed weather conditions this weekend. Some areas may experience rain while others stay dry. Residents should check forecasts before outdoor plans.

items.raw_excerpt: Plans have been put forward for a new development set to provide sheltered housing in a Galway village this week.
items.summary_en: New plans have been proposed for a development in a Galway village in Ireland. The project would provide sheltered housing for elderly residents along with a new medical centre.

items.raw_excerpt: Taking the S-Bahn to the Berlin airport? No you're not. Fortunately there are several alternative trains available.
items.summary_en: Berlin's S-Bahn trains that go to the airport are not running. The problem will last until the end of August. Passengers must use other trains to reach the airport.

items.title_en: Berlin train to airport broken until August ends

items.raw_excerpt: Did you find a new favourite place to visit in Italy this summer? Or do you have a tried-and-true summer spot you've been returning to year after year? Share your experience with fellow readers.
items.summary_en: The Local Italy asks readers to share their favourite off-the-beaten-path summer destinations. Readers can suggest hidden beaches, small towns, or quiet countryside spots they return to every year.

items.raw_excerpt: The state currently offers free public interpreters for essential services in Norway. However, a new parliamentary proposal may change this arrangement. What exactly is on the table?
items.summary_en: Norway currently provides free public interpreters for essential services to help foreign residents access healthcare and other important services. A new parliamentary proposal could end this free service for those who have lived in the country for a long time. The change would affect how long-term foreign residents receive language support in official situations.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이는 현재 외국인 주민들이 의료 및 기타 중요한 서비스를 이용할 수 있도록 무료 공공 통역사를 제공하고 있습니다. 새로운 의회 제안은 오랫동안 노르웨이에 거주해온 사람들에 대한 무료 서비스를 종료할 수 있습니다. 이 변경은 장기체류 외국인들이 공식 상황에서 언어 지원을 받는 방식에 영향을 미칠 것입니다.
items.title_en: Norway May End Free Interpreter Services for Long-Term Foreign Residents
items.title_ko: 노르웨이, 장기체류 외국인 대상 무료 통역 서비스 중단 검토
items.title_original: Could Norway end free public interpreter services for long-term foreign residents?

items.raw_excerpt: Security staff at Schiphol will begin short work stoppages and deliberately slow-downs in the coming days, after the airport and its three security firms missed a union deadline to ease a workload the unions say has become unmanageable. Travellers could face longer queues as a result. Unions FNV and CNV announced the action on Wednesday, after an ultimatum to Schiphol and the firms Securitas, I-SEC and Trigion expired at midday. The stoppages will be flagged only a few hours in...
items.summary_en: Security staff at Amsterdam Schiphol Airport started short strikes and slow-downs after a union deadline passed. Unions say the workload has become unmanageable. Passengers may face longer queues in the coming days.
items.summary_ko: 네덜란드 암스테르담 스키폴 공항 보안요원들이 노조의 요구 기한이 지나자 단기 파업과 작업 지연에 돌입했다. 노조 측은 업무량이 감당하기 어려운 수준이 되었다고 밝혔다. 향후 며칠간 승객들의 대기 시간이 길어질 수 있다.
items.title_en: Schiphol Airport security staff go on strike over workload

items.raw_excerpt: Experience a captivating multimedia laser show and musical fountain at Sanjeevaiah Park, Hyderabad, now open for visitors.
items.summary_en: A new multimedia laser show and musical fountain has opened at Sanjeevaiah Park in Hyderabad. Visitors can enjoy colorful lights and water displays at the park. The attraction is now open for everyone to experience.

items.raw_excerpt: Finding an affordable room to rent is becoming increasingly difficult in parts of Portugal, with asking prices reaching €527 a month as the number of rooms available on the market falls sharply.
items.summary_en: Finding an affordable room to rent is becoming increasingly difficult in parts of Portugal. Asking prices have reached €527 a month as the number of rooms available on the market falls sharply. This trend is making housing less accessible for many people.
